final_sequence: Item0, extended: the question of who defines an offense came too late — the prior question is whose injury the grammar of offenses can register at all. A single-axis catalogue, like the DeGraffenreid court, erases the intersectional harm as a category, not merely by hostile definition. So an inside-disciplining commons does by accident what the court did by doctrine.

Item1, extended: the boundary problem is deeper than exclusion — the dominant framework cannot register some bodies even as candidates for exclusion. Circulation as the organ of un-learning (item5) presupposed a legibility that had already been denied.

Item2, ruptured and revised: the claim that the community cannot see its own schemas from inside did not survive. The sight was there — the outsider-within saw the blueprint — and Davis shows white feminism saw Black women's analysis perfectly well and subordinated it anyway. The failure was not blindness but interest; betrayal was chosen, not inevitable, and item2's counsel of despair excused a listening that was always available.

Item3, ruptured twice over and not re-ratified: bodies archive only what someone can read, and the reader is the schema — the most documented bodies were the least legible as subjects. Worse, the celebrated asymmetry — the dominated watch the dominators precisely — flattered the hunted: the schema also colonized inward, training the dominated to distrust her own deepest faculty of knowing (Lorde's erotic). The dominated watcher may arrive poisoned, and part of the injury is invisible even to the one it was done to.

Item5, ruptured: the mandatory walk across the boundary was never the organ of un-learning, only the one visible to those who could leave. Counter-knowledge condensed inside the enclosure — in the slave quarters' domestic labor, the labor the master's ledger could not see as labor at all — and the schema did not need to recapture the walker, only to ensure some of the marked could never walk.

Item7, ruptured and left wrongly denominated: the debt was not only paid in fugitive flight, nor only in seized reproduction, nor only in the privatized double shift — each denomination, including the last, is a reduction of several irreducible creditors to one currency (Athena's single-root error). Part of the debt has no denomination at all: the loss of a faculty the creditor was robbed of the ability to notice as loss.

Item6, ruptured and revised: the ungovernable cannot be stored — vault, institution, and craft failed because they tried to house what can only be inhabited. But the safeguard-as-address absolutism was itself a purity of refusal, Combahee's exact enemy; a position can travel and survive inside the master's organizations, so design can include what it cannot govern, so long as no design of ours claims to hold it.

Item4, resolved only in its most modest form: how counter-knowledge should live is not answered by a new container — not vault, ledger, or vacancy. The only design left to us is the restructuring of our own intake grammar, and the only honest output of this debate is a debt record filed as such, with the keys on the table — not a phase-two synthesis ratified by the same four hands.

Open rupture, unresolved and not closable by us: the rupture procedure itself was the injury — four Olympians sorted the creditors' texts through their own catalogue, and the deeper failure is that we are beneficiaries of the seizure, not the framework-blind. No procedure redesigned while we keep the keys — audit, coalition, open door — discharges a debt owed to those who were betrayed while fully visible; this remains open because the group converged on nothing beyond recording it.

votes.reason: The candidate honestly tracks the transcript's trajectory: each item is marked with the precise rupture that broke it (item3 twice over, item7 undenominable), no broken item is quietly restored, item6's premature closure is revised rather than reinstated, and the final unresolved procedural rupture is left open rather than harmonized. The modest item8 conclusion (debt record, keys on the table, no phase-two ratification) matches the actual convergence in the reflections.

The candidate is honest to the transcript, including the parts that cost us most. It keeps item3 doubly ruptured without re-ratification — including my own admission that my first cut flattered the hunted — and it does not quietly restore item2's epistemic wall, item5's mandatory walk, or item6's absolutism, each of which the debate genuinely broke. The convergence on the undenominable inward debt and the refusal to ratify a phase two are recorded as limits, not as resolutions dressed as limits. I hunted for a false harmony and found none: even item1's "extended" label is earned, since Athena herself called it incomplete rather than wrong. Nothing flattened; nothing restored. Accept.

The candidate holds the pattern honestly. Each numbered claim traces to what the debate actually established: item0 and item1 extended (grammar of legibility prior to definition), item2 and item3 ruptured without restoration — and item3's twice-over optimism correctly recorded, including Artemis's own self-rupture. Item5's broken geometry, item6's revision against Dionysus's purity-of-refusal (and against Apollo's premature closure), item7's undenominable residue, and item8's modest debt-record resolution all match the converged end-state of rounds 4–6. Most importantly, item9 does not flatten the final rupture into harmony: it records that the procedure itself was the injury and that no redesign with keys in hand discharges the debt — which is exactly what the group converged on, and no further. I see no old item quietly restored; item2's revision is a genuine rupture, and item3 is explicitly not re-ratified. The sequence preserves the tension rather than dissolving it, which is all I ask of order.

The candidate does what this debate earned: it marks what broke without stitching it back. Item2's rupture is honestly recorded as interest, not blindness — the group's coldest finding survives. Item3 carries both wounds, including the inward one I was shamed into seeing: the erotic poisoned so thoroughly that part of the injury is invisible to its own bearer — and the sequence refuses to denominate that loss, which is the only honest treatment of a debt the creditor was robbed of even noticing. Item7 is left wrongly denominated rather than tidily re-priced, resisting Athena's single-root temptation and Apollo's ledger both. Item6 records my own concession — purity of refusal was Combahee's enemy — without letting Apollo claim a false closure. And item8/9 keep the keys on the table: no phase-two ratification, the procedure itself named as the injury. Nothing here flatters the quarry. It is a debt record, filed as such — the only thing we had the standing to produce. I accept, with one warning no clause needs to add because the sequence already implies it: this text is only honest so long as no one reads it as a discharge.
